$comment: Parameters that are not known yet. Empty string or empty array = not set. Identifiers and URLs only: NO secrets here (secrets live only in GitHub Secrets and in the hosting dashboard). Code must work when every value is empty. Copy to config/env.json when values become known (Phase 8 for connect-* items).

figma.$comment: Figma connector (claude.ai) is connected read-only since Phase 6 (ADR-0016): Professional plan, Full seat, the owner's personal team; files must be editable by that account (duplicate into the team). TODO(connect-figma-corporate), TODO(connect-figma-rest), Code Connect: see the Phase 8 checklist (ADR-0018).

hosting.$comment: Phase 5. Provider chosen in Phase 1 (ADR-0006): Cloudflare Workers + Static Assets + Workers Builds. Workers Free plan to start (owner decision); move to Workers Paid when the site nears 20k files or 100k requests/day. Password and signing key are Worker secrets in the Cloudflare dashboard, never here.

googleCloud.$comment: Phase 2a. Identifiers only; the WIF provider resource name and the service account email are not secrets. The JSON key (fallback path) goes to GitHub Secrets, never here.

drive.$comment: Proto, DS and Proto/Docs IDs live in config/drive.json. TODO(connect-drive-write): output folder for build archives, if ever needed — checklist in Proto/Docs/Playbooks (ADR-0018). DS stays read-only forever.

devices.$comment: Target devices for visual QA breakpoints and performance budgets (60 fps target device). To be confirmed in Phase 4.
